This release adds Splunk 10.4 interface support and includes security and integration updates.

* **Security notice:** Earlier app versions may use an affected CA trust bundle. Upgrade to 4.1.3, which updates Certifi to version 2026.10.19 or later.
* Improved TLS certificate verification for CII connections.
* Fixed an issue that could expose sensitive data in logs.
* Updated Cisco Secure Firewall syslog CIM support.
* Added Splunk 10.4 interface support.
* Updated the Cisco Secure Endpoint integration for deprecated Vulnerabilities API endpoints.
* Improved reliability when Cisco Secure Network Analytics processes top-flow events concurrently.

This release delivers upgraded Cisco XDR ingestion, improved Firewall and SNA reliability, expanded CIM-compliant parsing, dashboard corrections, and removal of the retired Isovalent integration.

### Highlights

* Upgraded Cisco XDR ingestion for incidents, detections, findings, and related telemetry, with improved pagination, retries, deduplication, checkpoints, configuration, and dashboard support.
* Improved Cisco Secure Firewall eStreamer performance by reducing bookmark-write overhead and protecting acknowledgement timing during high-volume collection.
* Added all eight ASA syslog severity levels to the severity filter.
* Added a bounded timeout for SNA report polling.
* Expanded CIM mappings for Secure Endpoint, Secure Firewall, ASA, Duo, and Secure Malware Analytics events.
* Removed the Isovalent integration from the application, backend, configuration, dashboards, and tests.
* Prevented stale exception states from carrying over between input stanzas.
* Fixed Advanced Logging dashboard syntax and malformed Markdown links.

Release Notes: Cisco Splunk App Update

We are pleased to announce the latest release, featuring key stability and performance improvements to enhance your monitoring experience.

Key Updates:

Cisco Secure Firewall

  • Log Parsing: Resolved issues with ASA log parsing following recent upgrades.
  • Certificate Management: Fixed eStreamer certificate errors occurring in FIPS-compliant environments.
  • Logging & Correlation: Added new event types and aliases for IPS, Connection, File, and 10.5 Advanced logs to improve event correlation.
  • Dashboard Enhancements: Corrected visualization issues for the "Weird Events by Country" tile within the Advanced Logging Dashboard.

SMA & Integration

  • API Improvements: Addressed discrepancies in the SMA API approach to ensure consistent data retrieval.

Compliance & Compatibility

  • Audit Remediation: Implemented critical configuration and syntax fixes based on recent security audit findings.
  • Cloud Compatibility: Verified and updated support for Cisco Security Cloud integration with the Splunk Cloud Platform.

Stability & Performance: Resolved input issues for Cisco Secure Endpoint and added the missing offset parameter for SMA API calls.

Data & Mapping: Improved Data Model (DM) mapping for Secure Firewall, updated field aliases for intrusion events, and optimized query timing for Secure Workload.

UI & Export: Fixed dashboard pagination overlaps and enhanced incident exports in Cisco XDR to include missing observables and asset identifiers.

Compliance & Standards: Implemented "Magic 8" best practices across Secure Workload, NVM, Multicloud Defense, Firewall, and AI Defense modules.

General Improvements: Updated ETD URLs for Fed-Prod environments and standardized product naming and CIM mapping within the Shell App.

### Release Notes – Cisco Security Cloud Splunk App
**Release Date: March 30, 2026**

---

We are pleased to announce the latest release of the **Cisco Security Cloud Splunk App**. This update delivers new feature enhancements, compliance improvements, and important bug fixes aimed at improving stability, usability, and security across multiple modules. We encourage all users to update to this latest version.

---

#### ✅ What's New – Enhancements

- **Test Automation:** Expanded automated test coverage for Advanced Logging to improve reliability and quality assurance.
- **Cisco Security Cloud Support:** Introduced support for the Cisco Security Cloud Splunk App integration.
- **Cisco Secure Email Threat Defense:** Updated the Fed-Prod URL to ensure uninterrupted service for federal production environments.
- **Cisco XDR:** Improved relay feedback integration for a more seamless XDR experience.
- **Version Management:** Implemented an in-app version check to help administrators stay current with the latest releases.
- **Security & Compliance – Magic 8 Best Practices:** Applied industry-aligned best practices across the following modules to enhance security posture and app performance:
    - CII
    - Endpoint
    - ETD
    - CVI
    - SMA
    - DUO

---

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **SMA Dashboard:** Corrected a misaligned pop-over menu on the Recent Samples tile for improved navigation.
- **Advanced Logging Dashboard:** Standardized tile title formatting for a consistent and professional appearance.
- **Shell Application:**
    - Resolved an issue where the Alerts and Detection Source Type filter failed to clear all data as expected.
    - Fixed radio button display styling that caused buttons to render as ellipses instead of circles.
- **AI Defense:** Fixed a missing Event Logs table title when no results were present, improving dashboard clarity.
- **Cisco Secure Endpoint:** Resolved a KVStore exception triggered during input creation on Cloud instances, restoring reliable cloud deployment functionality.

---

> 📌 **Note:** For installation instructions, compatibility requirements, or support, please refer to the official Cisco documentation or contact your Cisco representative.

This integration package enhances the ingestion and management of Isovalent and Cisco Secure Client data in Splunk. It includes the following key features and improvements:

Flexible Data Ingestion: Supports both OpenTelemetry Collector and manual ingestion via Splunk HEC, giving users flexibility in how data is onboarded.
Streamlined Configuration: Refactored Splunk props configurations for Isovalent data, aligning key settings with macros to ensure consistent field extractions and indexing.
Optimized Event Parsing: Restores default LINE_BREAKER settings for the standard cisco_isovalent sourcetype, improving event parsing accuracy.
Macro-Based Integration: Utilizes Splunk macros for the Isovalent product integration, enabling dashboards to function seamlessly whether data is sent directly from Tetragon or via Edge Processor.
Enhanced Data Categorization: Introduces a new sourcetype, cisco_isovalent_alert, for improved data organization and alert management.
Updated configuration page for Cisco NVM

The Cisco Cloud Security application offers a seamless integration experience for connecting your Cisco devices with Splunk, providing a rich and uniform interface. The application is equipped with detailed instructions to facilitate every step of the setup process and assists with monitoring to ensure that your data pipelines maintain their operational integrity.

The Cisco Cloud Security app combines the concept of both TA and Splunk App into a single offering to help improve the efficiency and effectiveness of your data analysis within Splunk, providing a more powerful monitoring solution

As of July 3rd, 2024, the application has been released as a BETA version and will receive ongoing updates, including new Cisco integrations and feature sets as the current Cisco Splunk integrations approach their end of life (EOL). The present version supports the following core Cisco Integrations:  

Cisco Secure Firewall (eStreamer/FTD/ASA), Cisco Multicloud Defense, Security Malware Analytics, Duo.

As of June 4th, 2024, the application has been released as a BETA version and will receive ongoing updates, including new Cisco integrations and feature sets as the current Cisco Splunk integrations approach their end of life (EOL).
